tasks.brief: Implement src/services/llm.py: Define constant FALLBACK_REPLY = 'I am sorry, Dave. I am afraid I cannot do that.' Define function generate_reply(message: str) -> str. Inside generate_reply, read LLM_ENDPOINT, LLM_MODEL, LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT, LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from os.environ (use defaults: 'http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions', 'local-model', '', 120). Construct request body: {"model": LLM_MODEL, "messages": ([{"role": "system", "content": LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT}] if LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT else []) + [{"role": "user", "content": message}], "stream": False}. Use httpx.Client.post(LLM_ENDPOINT, json=request_body, timeout=float(LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)). On success (response.status_code == 200), extract data = response.json(); content = data.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content"); if content: return content. On any exception (httpx.HTTPError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError, ValueError) or non-2xx status, return FALLBACK_REPLY. No other imports or symbols exported. Acceptance: generate_reply('test') with mocked httpx returning 200 with valid JSON returns the content string; with connection error returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with non-2xx returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with malformed JSON returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with empty content returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with timeout returns FALLBACK_REPLY. Config is read at call time.

Implement src/api/chat.py: Import generate_reply from src.services.llm. Define FastAPI APIRouter. Define POST /api/v1/chat endpoint. Define Pydantic model ChatRequest with field message: str. Endpoint accepts request body of type ChatRequest. Call generate_reply(request.message). Return dict {'reply': result}. Acceptance: POST /api/v1/chat with {"message": "test"} returns 200 with {'reply': 'mocked_reply'} (mock generate_reply); POST with missing message returns 422; POST with empty message returns 200 with {'reply': 'mocked_reply'} (mock generate_reply).

Implement src/main.py: Import FastAPI. Import APIRouter from src.api.chat. Create FastAPI app instance. Include the router from src.api.chat. Define GET / route. Serve src/static/index.html (resolve path relative to this module's directory) with Content-Type: text/html. Expose app as module-level symbol src.main:app. Acceptance: GET / returns HTML content with Content-Type text/html; app is importable as src.main:app.

Implement src/static/index.html: Self-contained HTML with inline CSS and JS. Render input field, on submit POST {"message": <text>} to /api/v1/chat. On response, append reply as chat bubble. Must contain literal endpoint path '/api/v1/chat'. Acceptance: HTML contains form/input, JS POSTs to /api/v1/chat, response reply is appended as bubble.
tasks.smoke_check: Verify HTML file contains '/api/v1/chat' literal string and has form/input elements with JS POST logic.
